title: Liveness: Verified survives reload; wait time in minutes

requirements.expectation: GET /api/profile, login and role-switch profiles carry faceLivenessVerified (and faceLivenessAt) from repair_pro_profiles, false when not passed.
evidence: code: profile route.test.ts 'returns the server-recorded Tier 3 liveness so a reload keeps Verified'; login-profile.test.ts and switch-profile.test.ts liveness cases. All four fail without the fix (checked locally by stashing the source changes).

requirements.expectation: A spent liveness budget returns 429 with Retry-After in seconds and a message in plain minutes or hours (1502 s -> 'about 26 minutes').
requirements.verification: Unit test of formatWait; liveness route test asserts the message.
evidence: code: src/lib/__tests__/format-wait.test.ts; liveness route.test.ts 429 case asserts 'Try again in about 26 minutes.'

requirements.expectation: lint has 0 errors; typecheck and the full test suite pass.
requirements.verification: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test.
evidence: code: 2026-11-23, uncommitted tree. lint: 0 errors, 141 warnings (none new). typecheck clean. test: 290 files, 2892 tests passed.

requirements.expectation: On dev, after a liveness pass, reloading /verify still shows Verified on the Tier 3 card.
On dev, exceeding the attempt budget shows the wait in minutes.

code: Independent review of the reviewed commit.
Optional: use formatWait in the other rate-limited routes.
